task: Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.
agent_final_answer:
Qatar Airways Economy Class baggage allowance (weights):

Carry-on baggage: 1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb) for all Economy fare types. (For flights to/from Brazil, Economy customers can carry one piece up to 10 kg / 22 lb.)

Checked baggage:
- Flights to/from Africa or the Americas (piece concept): Economy Lite = 1 piece up to 23 kg (50 lb); Economy Classic / Convenience / Comfort = 2 pieces up to 23 kg (50 lb) each.
- All other destinations (weight concept): Economy Lite = 20 kg (44 lb); Economy Classic = 25 kg (55 lb); Economy Convenience = 30 kg (66 lb); Economy Comfort = 35 kg (77 lb).
